sources.label: Morphe patches for Gemini with microG and Samsung Secure Folder support
sources.author: Gemini microG
patch_list: Automatic Clone Setup
Automatically creates the fixed .morphe clone and isolates its permissions and providers. No official Clone app or Expert mode configuration is required.
Compatible Play Store Update Blocking
Keeps Google and Gemini version checks working when Disable Play Store updates is also selected.
Gemini Redirect to Cloned Google App
Gemini アプリからの連携先 Google アプリをクローン版（com.google.android.googlequicksearchbox.morphe）へリダイレクトします。
Gemini Standalone Support
Geminiのsplit APK制約を除去します。Gemini本体機能には別途クローン版Googleアプリが必要です。

sources.label: Ariecos
sources.author: Ariecos
patch_list: GmsCore MicroG support
Injects MicroG-RE metadata into Gemini's manifest so it gets signature spoofing trust from MicroG-RE.
Route intents to patched apps
Replaces unused internal package names in Gemini's allowlist with Morphe-patched YouTube and YouTube Music package names.

sources.label: 🦈 D-moniak Patches (Dev) - Automated releases on every push
sources.author: D-moniak Patches (Dev)
patch_list: Allow Screenshots & UI Tweaks - Google Gemini (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Removes FLAG_SECURE window flags in Google Gemini to allow capturing chat responses and enhances privacy in floating assistant overlays.
AMOLED Dark Theme & Declutter - Google Gemini (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Injects true OLED pitch black (#000000) across Gemini chat surfaces and removes 'Try Gemini Advanced' upgrade suggestions.
Disable Response Haptics - Google Gemini (Experimental)
⚠️ [Experimental / Untested] Silences excessive continuous vibration buzzing during token streaming and AI response generation in Google Gemini.
